{{short description|German physicist}}
'''Manfred Schüssler''' is a German solar physicist at the [[Max Planck Institute for Solar System Research]].  In 2017, he was awarded the [[George Ellery Hale Prize]]<ref>{{cite web|url=http://spd.aas.org/SolarNews/2017/20170101.html|title=Solar News: The Electronic Newsletter of the Solar Physics Division, American Astronomical Society|date=January 2017}}</ref> and the Senior Prize of the Solar Physics Division of the [[European Physical Society]]<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.eps.org/blogpost/739454/284769/ESPD-prizes-awarded|title=ESPD prizes awarded|date=14 September 2017|website=European Physical Society|author=Tom Van Doorsselaere}}</ref> for his contributions to the study of the [[solar dynamo]].
